name: search_sessions
description: Search the user and agent messages of the sessions in scope by keywords. Words match by stem and common irregular forms (garden finds gardening, ran finds run); add related words to the same query (feline cat kitten) since any word counts. Nearby matches merge into one excerpt. Each result names its session and turn; open more with read_session from/to around that turn.

examples: find the session where we talked about billing
